-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Iron God of War.png  |title= Iron Magic |kanji= 鉄魔法 |romaji= Kurogane Mahō |english= Iron Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Gareth (Anime) #Yosuga Musyogatake }} {{Nihongo|Iron Magic|鉄魔法|Kurogane Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the users to generate and manipulate iron.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the users to generate and manipulate iron at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.{{Clr}}
